text:
Before: two slices of fruit bread (~45g each, ~90g total, ~250 kcal), a blueberry muffin (~50g, ~190 kcal), an English muffin with cheese (~90g, ~250 kcal), a white coffee (~200ml, ~60 kcal) and butter portions.

After: about half the fruit bread remains (crusts), so ~50g eaten (~140 kcal). The muffin, the English muffin with cheese and one butter (~10g, 70 kcal) are gone. About half the coffee was drunk (~100g, ~30 kcal).

Total: 140 + 190 + 250 + 70 + 30 = 680 kcal; mass ≈ 50 + 50 + 90 + 10 + 100 = 300 g.

{"kcal": 680, "mass_g": 300}
